title: Derived tensor reduction without internal-Hom comparison data
statement: Let C,J,B,tau and A be as in [def-coef-semilinear-tensor-reduction-models]. For arbitrary derived systems P,Q and n<=m, the actual scalar-adjunction reduction of their derived tensor, followed by tensorEvaluation at n, equals scalar extension of tensorEvaluation at m, then scalarTensor comparison, then tensor of the two actual reductions. The precise equation is lean.statement. The reductions need not be invertible; there is no internal-Hom comparison or cartesianness assumption.

source.place: Construction 4.1, printed p.21 (singleton extension and below-level scalar extension); Proposition 4.17(a), printed pp.25-26 (tensor projection). Stacks Tags 03EK, 06YY, 07A4, 06YT and 0FND supply the module tensor and normalized derived-adjunction constructions.

proof.text: Choose flat-term K-flat representatives of P and Q. Evaluation preserves flat terms and the tensor-model K-flat class. The total tensor remains K-flat. The normalized scalar transpose formula identifies each actual reduction followed by its resolution comparison with the localized cochainReduction.

Localize the cochain tensor-reduction identity. The model derived squares identify the chain comparisons with scalarTensor and tensorEvaluation. An elementary naturality diagram, cancelling the invertible model comparisons, gives the claimed formula on representatives.
The two sides are natural transformations on pairs of derived systems. Their equality on the chosen representatives transports along their isomorphisms to arbitrary P,Q.

lean.statement:
theorem semilinearTensorReductionFromModels (A : SystemTensorReductionModels.{c, v, r} J B τ)
    (P Q : DS.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ) :
    ∀ {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m),
      reduction.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ h (A.scalar h) (A.closed.tensor.obj (P, Q)) ≫
          (A.tensorEvaluation n).hom.app (P, Q) =
        (A.scalar h).T.map ((A.tensorEvaluation m).hom.app (P, Q)) ≫
          (A.scalarTensor h).hom.app
            ((e.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ m).obj P, (e.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ m).obj Q) ≫
          (A.levelClosed n).tensor.map
            (Prod.mkHom (reduction.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ h (A.scalar h) P)
              (reduction.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ h (A.scalar h) Q))
